reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and there's nothing here showing reviews, Trustpilot or a track record, so I'd be Googling 'is norafurnish legit' before I'd even think about paying. objection: No reviews or track record that I can see, and I eat the return shipping on a big fixture if I just change my mind.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of verified third-party reviews (Trustpilot or similar) with photos from real buyers, plus free returns or a prepaid return label on large fixtures.
